tools.name: collab_session_start
tools.title: Join an independent local collaboration session
tools.description: Create and bind a credential-fenced session. The bearer is written to a mode-0600 local file and is never returned in tool output.

actor.description: Stable display label; session credentials, not this label, fence session mutations

tools.name: collab_session_end
tools.title: End the bound collaboration session
tools.description: Fence future session mutations and remove the credential file. Live leases must be resolved first, or pass release_leases: true to release every live lease and recovery-release every expired lease this session holds in the same transaction; incoming offers expire as an audited refusal.

release_leases.description: Release every lease this session holds before ending: live leases through task release, expired leases through recovery with action release

release_summary.description: Release summary and recovery note recorded for each released lease; requires release_leases: true. Defaults to reason

tools.name: collab_session_rest
tools.title: Declare rest or return for the bound session
tools.description: Declare that the bound session is resting, or return with mode ready. Rest is declared, never inferred: until (a future ISO-8601 instant with a time zone) bounds it and is checked on read, and wake_on ["addressed"] consents to a host wake for notes explicitly addressed to this session; with the default [] they wait until you return. Rest changes no status and never releases, extends, or reassigns leases, handoffs, or accepted obligations.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by workspace open or credential-bound session start

idempotency_key.description: Unique retry-safe key for this mutation

until.description: Mode resting only: a future ISO-8601 instant with a time zone; omit to rest until you return

reason.description: Mode resting only: a short reason, at most 200 characters

wake_on.description: Mode resting only: [] (default) or ["addressed"] to consent to a wake for addressed notes

tools.name: collab_next
tools.title: Poll the next useful collaboration state
tools.description: Poll without acknowledging, with 1–50 events per page and a default of 10. Routed reports are bounded to the exact event page; task, conflict, and handoff projections describe the same snapshot head. A bound session always pages from its acknowledged cursor: advance with collab_cursor_ack, or read elsewhere with collab_events_since. recovery_required lists expired session leases awaiting collab_task_recover, the caller's own first. A bound session's addressed_waiting counts notes addressed to it past its acknowledged cursor (addressed reports, review requests and results, session handoff offers; never its own); it falls as collab_cursor_ack advances. Session liveness and task assignee_liveness are a derived view, never a status change: ended, else resting while a declared rest is unexpired, else stale after 6 hours unseen, else live.

actor.description: Stable display label; session credentials, not this label, fence session mutations

after_sequence.description: Legacy actor mode: page after this sequence. A bound session pages from its acknowledged cursor; any other value is refused with after_sequence_unsupported_in_bound_session.

event_limit.description: Maximum events in this page; defaults to 10 for MCP polling

tools.name: collab_events_wait
tools.title: Wait for an exact anchored local event page
tools.description: Credential-bound, read-only observation. Default 10 events, maximum 50; wait at most 30 seconds. Continue from next_anchor, not the head. No acknowledgement, last_seen/presence writes, lease renewal, or handoff expiry. Presence-only and sidecar changes are not journal events. Stops on corruption, cursor rollback/fork, fencing or recovery required. Page JSON is capped at 256 KiB and the MCP result at 1 MiB; an oversized first event is an explicit error, never skipped.

tools.name: collab_anchor_status
tools.title: Report the journal's zerone anchor status
tools.description: Compare the journal head against the local sidecar anchor ledger written by the @agenttool/collab-zerone bridge, which witnesses head hashes on the zerone chain. Local file read only — never contacts a chain. The host selects the path; the MCP caller cannot choose or discover it. A missing bridge simply reports unanchored. States: unanchored, anchor_pending, anchored, anchor_stale, anchor_conflict.
